P01.rationale: There is no founder portrait or human anchor on this page; it consists entirely of text and a QR code.

P05.rationale: The case studies are presented as generic numbered steps without any client portraits or named clients.

P07.rationale: There is no social-proof apparatus such as a press wall, rating cards, or testimonials present on the page.

P10.rationale: No oversized decorative typographic elements like giant numerals or quote glyphs are used; typography is standard body text.

P11.rationale: There are no data-visualisations bound to numbers (charts, cost-math) present on the page.

P12.rationale: The page reads as a dense, magazine-quality editorial layout that fills the sheet with text and structured steps.

P13.rationale: There is no intentional background texture or atmosphere; the page relies on standard white space and black bars.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photo with overlaid text is present to evaluate for readability treatment.

P16.rationale: There are no device or product mockups shown on the page; only a QR code and text are visible.

N07.rationale: The single image of a construction worker appears generic/stock rather than specific to a real business context.

N08.rationale: There is minimal dead whitespace; the page is densely packed with text and structured content.

N10.rationale: Text does not sit on a busy photo without scrim or awkward inset gaps as it is contained within white columns.
